scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const candidates=[process.env.INIT_CWD,process.env.npm_config_local_prefix,'/home/palmvine/repositories/Errant',process.cwd(),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../../..')].filter(Boolean);let root=candidates.find(p=>fs.existsSync(path.join(p,'prisma/schema.prisma')));if(!root){console.error('[postinstall] Could not locate prisma/schema.prisma in candidate paths:',candidates);process.exit(1);}const schema=path.join(root,'prisma/schema.prisma');console.log('[postinstall] Found schema at:',schema);cp.execSync('npx prisma generate --schema="'+schema+'"',{cwd:root,stdio:'inherit'});"
